correctness.rationale: For all integers \(n\ge3\) and all positive real \(\mu\), direct block multiplication gives the exact same-shore Green entry \(\kappa=n/[\mu(\mu+n)(\mu+2n)]\) and cross-shore entry \(\chi=1/[\mu(\mu+2n)]\). The independent class-Rademacher variance is \(4\kappa^2\) times the weighted within-class unordered-pair count. A strict same-size opposite-shore vertex exchange proves at most one mixed class; a second strict purification excludes two pure classes on the same shore. The exact reduced gain is \(D(a,b)=ns-s^2+(2-\theta)ab\), where \(s=a+b\) and \(\theta=(1+\mu/n)^2\). This yields the three exact regimes, all optimizer ties and the sharp threshold \(\mu=n(\sqrt2-1)\). For \(\theta<2\), maximizing \(ab\) and the strictly decreasing integer first differences gives the stated one-dimensional formula; for \(\theta\ge2\), a sharp quadratic bound completes the classification. The supplied Python standard-library checker passed 35,610 exact assertions, including complete \(3\le n\le6\) partition census and direct rational inverses. The finite tests supplement rather than replace the universal proof.

originality.rationale: The closest retrieved and fully inspected published biclique probing theorem explicitly optimizes exactly two classes. The new theorem optimizes exactly three classes and detects a sharp all-finite-size improper/proper transition that cannot be inferred from its two-color formula; in fact the two-color balanced-biclique optimum is proper for all shifts. The 2013 hierarchical-probing source and the 2023 stochastic-probing analysis provide construction and variance identities but no all-partition, three-color biclique optimizer. The listed literature and indexed searches provide positive distinction evidence, not a guarantee against unindexed equivalences.

value.rationale: For a fixed budget of three matrix-vector actions, conventional proper biclique coloring ceases to minimize trace-estimator variance below the sharp threshold \(\mu=n(\sqrt2-1)\); in contrast, for exactly two actions the proper balanced-biclique partition is optimal for every positive screening strength. The result is a complete, all-real-parameter classification for a natural sparse-inverse benchmark; it gives exact minimum variance, every optimizer, a discrete finite-size staircase, and optimizer counts without exponential search. This is a motivated structural warning against automatically reusing proper graph coloring when the probe budget changes.
